role: @MainActor service that owns per-session and bulk re-analysis (artifact detection, window selection, re-classification, re-scoring, archive write, baseline update, CloudKit re-upload), score-only rebuilds, the one re-score builder (rescoredBreakdown) and the static readiness / insufficient-data / ANS-balance helpers used by morning processing, acceptance, migrations and sample data.
types: ReanalysisService: class — re-analysis / re-score service built lazily by SessionReanalysisCoordinator (RRCollector+Reanalysis.swift:23) with injected archive, HealthKit, pipeline, selector, detector, baseline tracker and provider/callback closures
state: closures settingsProvider, scoringConfigProvider, ansConfigProvider, trainingContextProvider, analyzeWithWindow, analyzeFullSession, onArchiveChanged, onSessionUploaded (ReanalysisService.swift:86-110); analysisPipeline/ansConfigProvider are only used in ReanalysisService+Sleep.swift:214-218
toplevel: No top-level code; the class is @MainActor. Its doc says dependencies are injected, with one exception: persist reaches AppDependencies.current.app.organizedZonesCache. Sleep retro-apply and manual window paths live in ReanalysisService+Sleep.swift extension.
